Bolivia
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Madrid, Espańa,the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Roma or bythe Consulate General in Milano, Italia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Berlin.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Republic of Bolivia are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
